examples.text: ‘Good evening, good evening,’ Father Rank called. His stride lengthened and he caught a foot in his soutane and stumbled as he went by. ‘A storm’s coming up,’ he said. ‘Got to hurry,’ and his ‘ho, ho, ho’ diminished mournfully along the railway track, bringing no comfort to anyone.

glosses: To take away; to subtract.

examples.text: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the Lord your God which I command you.

glosses: Enlever, ôter, retirer.

examples.text: Z’n hoed afdoen.

glosses: Liquider, terminer, trancher.

examples.text: Een afgedane zaak.
Een zaak haastig afdoen.

examples.translation: Je ne veux plus en entendre parler.

glosses: Statuer sur, juger.
